description: Lists this account's scheduled posts and comments, newest first. Returns `actions` and `count`. Each action carries `id`, `type`, `status` (scheduled, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled), `run_at`, the stored `request`, `created_at`, `finished_at`, `result` (what the post or comment returned, when the run succeeded), `error` (`code`, `message` and `http_status`, when the run failed) and `billed`: true for a run that succeeded, false for one that failed with an answer or was cancelled, null when the outcome was not confirmed (error EXECUTION_UNCONFIRMED or EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED, where the post or comment may still have been made and charged). Free.

status.description: Only actions in this status. Absent, every status is listed.

name: reddit_scheduled_list
title: List Scheduled Actions
